newsitem.title: USA: Sundstrand in talks with Labinal.
newsitem.headline: Sundstrand in talks with Labinal.

text.p: Sundstrand Corp said it and Labinal S.A. initiated talks about Sundstrand acquiring Labinal's interest in Auxiliary Power International Corp, a joint venture the two companies formed in 1989.
The joint venture provides auxiliary power units for the commercial transport airline market.

Sundstrand said it would take over all responsibilities associated with Auxiliary Power International (APIC) and would integrate its activities into the Power Systems division of Sundstrand located in San Diego, Calif.

Sundstrand president Robert Jenkins said, "With its proven performance and reliability record, APIC has made substantial progress in attaining a meaningful market position in a short time. The dynamics of the served international airlines market requires a rapid response which can be enhanced by single ownership."
It expects that ownership transition to begin in 1997.
Sundstrand manufactures technology-based components and subsystems for aerospace and industrial markets.
